265 Melrose Street
Providence, Rhode Island 02907

May 12, 1972
Chief, Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U.S. Department of the Interior Washington, D.C. 20240
Dear Sir:
The draft environmental impact statement prepared by your agency on the proposed "endangered species conservation act of 1972" has been reviewed by this office. As part of this review, copies of a summary of the draft statement were referred to parties believed to be interested in this matter.
Review of this proposal discloses no significant adverse environmental impacts. Reservation of selected areas as habitat for endangered species, although probably not affecting this state to any great extent, could have substantial other benefits in preservation of open space. Although some adverse impacts on the economy may occur, these should be relatively minor in light of the benefits gained, and in some cases, should be relatively short-term impacts. Again, this is not expected to be a serious problem in Rhode Island.
Thank you for the opportunity to review this draft state-ment.
Yours very truly,
Daniel W. Varin
Chief, Statewide Planning
